evidence: Wilson, Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire (2014): Populus tremula L., Aspen
terms.comment: Linnaeus’s name, “the trembling poplar”; we have found no ancient name for the tree. Both words are in Lewis & Short and are marked from it.

sources: Rob Wilson, A Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire & The Soke of Peterborough (2014), on the website of the Botanical Society of Britain and Ireland.
Lewis & Short: populus · Lewis & Short: tremulus
